content: ⸤Isirele yambomanga ou pulu pulu anda kolepa⸥ Eporayamo kinie* pe yandopa ⸤enenga ye nomi kingi aili⸥ Depisi kinie eltene Yesusi Kirasi** kalko liringili mele i sipe:
Eporayamone Aisake merimu;

content.text: Jekopone Juda kinie Judanga angenupilime kinie

content: Judane Peresi kinie Sera kinie merimu,
Ramone Aminadape merimu;
Sallimonone Boasi merimu, Boasi yunge anumu Reapa;

content.text: Boasini Opete merimu, Opete yunge anumu Rute;

content: Jesini ye nomi kingi Depisi merimu.*
Depisini Sollomono merimu. Sollomononga anumu

content.text: Pe Depisini kanu ambomo konopu monjipe
Yuraya topa konjipe ambomo yu lirimu.**

content: Sollomonone Riapoamo merimu;
Etane Josipate merimu;
Asayane Jotamo merimu;
Esikayane Manasa merimu;
Josayane Jekonaya kinie yunge angenupilime kinie

content.text: merimu. Josaya kolopili yunge malopili molangi opa
tou yamboma Isirele yamboma kinie ongo opa
tekolie toko munduku Isirele yambo aisili ka siku
enenga kolea aili Bepillono mengo puringi.*

content: Ka siku mengo puringi kinie pe
Serapapelene Apayate merimu;
Esone Sedoke merimu;
Ellayatene Elliesa merimu;
Jekopone Josepo merimu.

content.text: Josepo Maria menu. Josepone Maria ou naa lipili
Maria yu ambolango olona monjipe molorumu.

content: ⸤Pulu Yemone “Ene nokopa konjimbe ye nomi te lipu mundumbu.” ou nimbe mako torumu yemo pe Yesusi aku yemo omba molorumuna⸥ yunge imbi te pea sikulie ‘Kirasimu’* niringila.

Eporayamo kinie Eporayamone yandopa yandopa kalopa lipe Depisi kalopa lipe terimu yema ⸤Yesusinge⸥ anda kolepa tene po* moloringi. Pe Depisini yandopa yandopa ou Bepillono yambomane Juda yambo mare ka siku Bepillono anju naa mengo pangi anda kolepa tene pola moloringi. Bepillono ka siku mengo puringi kinie pe yandopa ye nomi Kirasimu kinie kalko liringi ye tene pola moloringi.

Yesusi, Pulu Yemone “Ene nokopa konjimbe ye te lipu mundumbu.” ou nimbe mako torumu ye nomi Kirasimu,* yu meringi temanemo i sipe: Yunge anumu Marianga pulu lerimu yambomane “Maria Josepone lipili.” ningu koronga niringi nakolo ou Josepo pea teluna naa peangili Mini Kake Telimuni Maria yunge olona ambolango te monjinjirimumu Maria yuyu pilirimu.

Kanu kinie yunge ye Josepo yu ye sumbi nilimu molorumuna Maria ambolango monjirimu kinie pilipelie ‘Maria olie naa polopili.’ nimbe ‘Yambo aisili molangi yu temu mele nimbu para naa sipu yu yuyu molomba kinie kiyongo nimbu we “Kamu pui.” niembo.’ konopu lerimu.

Josepo aku sipe konopu lipe mundupe molopili Ailimunge angello tene Josepo uru kumbu sipelie nimbendo: “Josepo, ye nomi kingi Depisini kalopa lirimu yemo, Mini Kake Telimuni Maria ulu te terimuna yu ambolangomo olana monjilimo kene yu linindu pipili naa kolko li.” nirimu.

“Yu kango kanopa limbe. Kanu kangomone yunge yamboma ‘Enenga konopuna ulu pulu keri telemelema pepili molkolie mindili nonge.’ nimbe ene lipe taponjipe, mindili nolemelka ulkena wendo lipe, yu kinie pea molko konjingí aulkena lipe monjimbe kene yunge imbi lelko “Yesusi”* nieni.” nirimu.
Aku sipe wendo orumu ulumanga pali koronga ou Pulu Yemone ungu umbu tonjirimuma pilipe yamboma nimbe sirimu ye tene ulu mare pe wendo ombá ou nirimu mele kamu wendo orumu. Akumu i sipe:
“Pilieyo.

content.text: Ambo wenepo tene ambolango olona monjipelie
Kanu kinie yunge imbi lelko “Imenuele” ningí.”*

content: nirimu. I imbimunge ungu pulumu ‘Pulu Yemo** olio kinie molemo’.
Josepo uru pepa makilipelie Ailimunge angellomone nirimu mele pilipe lipe tepalie ambomo lirimu.
Nakolo yu ambolangomo ou naa mepili “Teluna naa peambili.” nirimu. Pe Mariane kango te merimu kinie* Josepo yuni yunge imbi lepa “Yesusi” nirimu.**
